episodes.title: Something Wicca This Way Comes
episodes.summary: Reunited in the grand Victorian home of their childhood a trio of sisters; Prue, Piper & Phoebe discover they are gifted witches. Little do they know that their new-found powers mean that they are now prey to evil forces

episodes.title: I've Got You Under My Skin
episodes.summary: Using her burgeoning powers to see into the future, Phoebe sees a handsome photographer in her future. As a result, she and her sisters are forced to dive into using witchcraft to fight a powerful demon posing as Phoebe's photographer friend. Piper fears that using her powers will cause negative repercussions in her life, especially if she were to enter a church. Prue gets a job at a local auction house.

episodes.title: Thank You for Not Morphing
episodes.summary: When their long-lost father drops by out of the blue following a 20 year absence; Prue starts to wonder what he's up to, while Piper and Phoebe are thrilled and invite him to stay for dinner. As the sisters deal with their father, they're unaware that the new neighbors are shapeshifting mutants, out to get their hands on the book of shadows.

episodes.title: Dead Man Dating
episodes.summary: When a young man is recently murdered in Chinatown by the leader of a local gang, his spirit turns to Piper and Phoebe for help in ensuring his earthly remains get a proper burial before an ancient, evil spirit is able to steal his soul. As Piper and Phoebe set out to plan a surprise party for Prue's birthday, Prue is in for a surprise when she sees Andy having lunch with his ex-wife.

episodes.title: Dream Sorcerer
episodes.summary: Prue's sleep is disturbed when a science experiment goes wrong that gives a wheelchair bound man the ability to invade the subconscious of others – especially women who politely decline his advances. When Piper and Phoebe discover what happened, they have to find a way to keep Prue safe while stopping the dream sorcerer.

episodes.title: The Wedding from Hell
episodes.summary: After Piper is hired to cater an upcoming wedding, she and her sisters suspect that the bride-to-be is a demon set out to marry the groom against his will so she can become pregnant with his child. Following the death of the priest who was set to perform the ceremony and Phoebe's premonition of a demon baby being born, the sisters set out to help save the groom so he can marry the right girl.

episodes.title: The Fourth Sister
episodes.summary: When Piper, Prue and Phoebe are befriended by a troubled young witch, she hopes they'll take her under their wings and become her mentors. However, things change when she gets lured by a sorceress into pursuing dark magic and the sisters try to break the sorceress' spell over the girl. Meanwhile, as Piper and Phoebe vie for Leo's attention, Prue tries to find time to spend with Andy.

episodes.title: The Truth Is Out There... and It Hurts
episodes.summary: When a warlock from the future arrives in town to kill the people involved in developing a vaccine against evil warlocks, Phoebe has to find his next victim before he does. Meanwhile, after Prue casts a truth spell to see how Andy will take her being a witch, she accidentally includes Piper and Phoebe in on it too. They then begin to realize that while being told the truth can be a good thing, though in some cases, it can really hurt feelings as well.

episodes.title: The Witch Is Back
episodes.summary: After Prue accidentally releases a warlock that was trapped inside an old curse, she ultimately gets attacked by him. She, Piper, and Phoebe then have to call upon the witch who bound him in the curse that held him for centuries: their ancestor Melinda Warren, before he can attack them for their powers, especially after he gains a pair of unlikely allies. Meanwhile, Piper works up the courage to ask Leo out, and Andy gets frustrated by Prue always showing up at the crime scenes where bizarre occurrences take place.

episodes.title: Wicca Envy
episodes.summary: After Prue is accused of stealing a priceless tiara from the Auction House, she is stunned to discover Rex and Hannah are warlocks, set to destroy the power of the charmed ones. When Piper and Phoebe set out to prove Prue's innocence, Rex and Hannah blackmail them to turn over the book of shadows and their powers to them. However, their plan is foiled by a guardian angel that comes to help the sisters.

episodes.title: Feats of Clay
episodes.summary: Phoebe and Prue have their hands full when an ex-boyfriend of Phoebe's shows up looking for Prue to auction off a stolen and cursed Egyptian urn, all while trying to keep the auction house from closing due to bankruptcy. Meanwhile, Piper decides to use her powers in an attempt to match up a couple employees at Quake, but ultimately her intentions may backfire.

episodes.title: The Wendigo
episodes.summary: While driving, Piper's car breaks down and she ultimately gets attacked by an ancient creature called Wendigo. She ultimately gets saved by a passerby named Billy, but not before being scratched and as a result, starts to transform into a Wendigo as well. As a result, Prue and Phoebe have to find a way to save Piper before it's too late. Elsewhere, Andy teams up with an FBI agent hunting the Wendigo with disastrous results. After Prue hires Phoebe to work at the auction house, Phoebe has a vision involving a car crash and missing child.

episodes.title: From Fear to Eternity
episodes.summary: Every 1,300 years, on Friday the 13th, the Demon of Fear preys upon 13 unmarried witches, looking to feed of their greatest fear before midnight. As he sets his sights on the charmed ones, they realize that the only way to defeat the demon is to overcome their greatest fears.

episodes.title: Secrets and Guys
episodes.summary: When a young witch named Max is kidnapped by a pair a crooks, intent on using his powers to hold up a bank, he is able to reach out via an Ouija board to Prue for help in being rescued. While Piper is dealing with Quake's new chef and his antics, Phoebe is shocked to learn a secret about Leo and has a difficult time trying to keep that secret from her sisters.

episodes.title: Is There a Woogy in the House?
episodes.summary: When an Earthquake hits San Francisco, Prue, Piper, and Phoebe have to call the gas company to repair a leak in the basement. However, once the repairman arrives, he is possessed by the woogyman – a shadow demon previously defeated by Grams. After he banishes Prue and Piper from the house, he possesses Phoebe and in order to defeat the demon the sisters have to find a way to banish it again and save Phoebe.

episodes.title: Which Prue Is It, Anyway?
episodes.summary: After Phoebe has a premonition about an evil warlock killing Prue to obtain her powers, Prue decides to cast a spell to multiply her powers. However, it doesn't turn out like she expected and as a result, she makes multiple copies of herself. As Piper and Phoebe try to find the best way to warn Prue not fight the warlock on her own, Andy gets some rather surprising news from the medical examiner. Prue and Piper are surprised to find out Phoebe has signed up for a self defense course.

episodes.title: That '70s Episode
episodes.summary: After Prue, Piper, and Phoebe cross paths with a Warlock named Nicholas, they discover that he is intent on obtaining their powers by any means necessary. When they discover that he's immune to their powers thanks to an agreement with their mother, they cast a spell to go back in time to the day the deal was made, hoping to stop their mother from going through with it.

episodes.title: When Bad Warlocks Go Good
episodes.summary: After Prue befriends a young man studying to become a priest, she soon discovers that he is half mortal, half warlock and trying his best to resist the urge to succumb to evilness and join his half-brothers to complete the triangle of evil Charmed Ones. Phoebe tries to talk Piper into dating Josh.

episodes.title: Out of Sight
episodes.summary: After the sisters witness a child being kidnapped in the park, a journalist witnesses Prue use her powers to try to stop the kidnapping and vows to expose her secret. As she deals with the journalist, Piper and Phoebe learn that the kidnapper is a Grimlock and its motive is to kidnap young children in order to steal their eyesight and set out to find out the best way to destroy the demon. Piper makes a surprising discovery about Josh. Andy finally learns about the powers that the sisters hold.

episodes.title: The Power of Two
episodes.summary: As Piper prepares to go on a business trip to Hawaii, she worries about how Prue and Phoebe will handle any magical crisis that might come up while she's gone. Meanwhile, Phoebe goes on a sight-seeing trip to Alcatraz, where she comes across a spirit. It takes possession of a security guard, in order to make his way across the water and seek revenge on the people who were behind his conviction. As a result, Phoebe and Prue have to find a way to banish the spirit before it's too late.

episodes.title: Love Hurts
episodes.summary: Piper is surprised when Leo returns to town, looking for her help in protecting an innocent woman from being stalked by demon stalker. It is only after Piper casts a spell on Leo that she discovers that he is a whitelighter assigned to protect the Charmed Ones. As a result of the spell, Prue and Phoebe's powers get switched as well and as a result, their powers are weak when they go up against the demon, but ultimately are able to save the day.

episodes.title: Déjà Vu All Over Again
episodes.summary: A demon, posing as Police Inspector Rodriguez tries to kill the charmed ones, and ultimately gets some help from another demon called Tempus. As time gets turned back until the demon succeeds in his mission, Phoebe has a troubling premonition where she sees Andy dying by the hand of the demon Inspector and unfortunately, the sisters are unsuccessful in saving him.

episodes.title: Witch Trial
episodes.summary: On the anniversary of when they received their powers, the Charmed Ones are forced to face a cloven-hooved demon named Abraxas, who ultimately steals the book of shadows and undoes their spells that releases all the demons the sisters faced in the past. The sisters soon discover that Abraxas is starting to erase the book of shadows, and if he succeeds, they'll lose their powers forever. While dealing with their crisis, Prue, Piper, and Phoebe meet their new neighbors.

episodes.title: Morality Bites
episodes.summary: When Phoebe has a premonition where she dies after using her powers to kill a man in the year 2009, Piper and Prue travel into the future to figure out what happens before the D.A. brings about a modern day witch hunt where Phoebe gets burned at the stake. While in the future, Piper and Prue are surprised at how their lives turn out.

episodes.title: The Painted World
episodes.summary: When Prue discovers a man trapped in a painting that was brought into the Auction House, she unwittingly gets trapped inside it with him when she casts a spell when trying to save him. As a result, Piper and Phoebe have to find a way to save Prue, especially after discovering the man may have been cast inside the painting by his warlock lover. After Piper ends up in the painting as well, Phoebe has to use her newfound smarts to save them and banish the warlocks inside the painting. Looking to bring her club up to code, Piper turns to Dan for help.

episodes.title: The Devil's Music
episodes.summary: In order to bump up business at her club, Piper readily agrees to let the band Dishwalla preform there when their manager asks for a place to play. However, Piper is unaware that the manager is possessed by a demon that promises success and money in exchange for the souls of young people who would do anything to meet the band. When Jenny, the Charmed Ones neighbor, gets taken by the demon, the girls have to vanquish the demon in order to save Jenny and his other victims.

episodes.title: She's a Man, Baby, a Man!
episodes.summary: When Phoebe starts having dreams about seducing and killing men, Piper and Prue discover that Phoebe is somehow connected to a femme fatale demon called a Succubus. Upon learning that the Succubus is killing and draining her victims in order to reproduce, Prue takes it upon herself to cast a spell where she becomes a man in order to stop the Succubus. While Prue is under the influence of her spell, she encourages Piper to go out with Dan.

episodes.title: That Old Black Magic
episodes.summary: When a trio of film students accidentally release an evil witch from the tomb that held her for 200 years, she kills them and then sets out to find her magical scepter that is needed to kill the Chosen One. As a result, Leo returns to town and asks for the Halliwell's help in keeping the Chosen One safe so he can destroy the evil witch.

episodes.title: They're Everywhere
episodes.summary: After fearing that the guys they're dating are warlocks, Piper and Prue decide to cast a mind reading spell to find out the truth. They then have to use their new power to help out a young man who translated ancient tablets that can foretell the future and ultimately became a target of a pair of brain-zapping warlocks called the Collectors.

episodes.title: P3 H2O
episodes.summary: When the water demon that killed the Charmed Ones mother 20 years ago returns and starts killing again, Prue, Piper, and Phoebe must face him at the same camp where Patty was drowned to death. While there, they meet Sam, their mother's former white-lighter and learn some shocking secrets about their mother, one of which mirrors Piper's relationship with Leo. Prue goes to some drastic lengths to vanquish the water demon.

episodes.title: Ms. Hellfire
episodes.summary: When an assassin called Ms. Hellfire sent to kill the Halliwells and all other witches on Friday the 13th is killed, Prue assumes her identity to find out who hired her. Prue soon finds this harder than usual since her boss gives her an ultimatum that she and Jack sell $100,000 worth of goods otherwise they'll be fired. After she is able to continue her investigation, Prue and her sisters have their paths crossed with the demon Barbas. Darryl learns that the sisters are witches.

episodes.title: Heartbreak City
episodes.summary: When Cupid has his magic ring of love stolen by Drazi, the demon of hate, he turns to Phoebe for help in getting it back. However, when Drazi uses the ring to get Piper and Dan, Prue and Jack, and other couples to break up to destroy Cupid, Phoebe needs Prue to use her new power of astral projection to vanquish Drazi for good and get Cupid his ring back. To show his thanks before leaving town, Cupid gives Phoebe a parting kiss.

episodes.title: Reckless Abandon
episodes.summary: When Phoebe has a powerful vision involving a ghost looking to exact revenge on an apparently abandoned baby, she talks Darryl into letting her take the baby back to the manor in order to protect him. Prue and Piper assist by tracking down the matriarch of the baby's family to discover the reason why the ghost is trying to harm the baby before he meets the same fate as the other male members of the family. While this is going on, Jack tries to convince Prue to go on a business trip with him, and Piper and Dan get a taste in what life would be like while watching over the baby.

episodes.title: Awakened
episodes.summary: After Piper contracts a rare fever from an illegal fruit, she slips into a coma at the hospital. Desperate to help her, Prue and Phoebe cast a spell to transfer the disease from Piper and into a doll. However, that doesn't work when the doll comes to life and starts stabbing people and as a result, the sisters have to transfer the disease back to Piper. As a result, Leo arrives and defies his orders to not interfere and ultimately saves Piper. At the Auction House, Prue decides to quit after Jack and their boss try to pass off a painting as a real Monet.

episodes.title: Animal Pragmatism
episodes.summary: When Phoebe unknowingly helps some college friends turn a trio of animals into guys on Valentine's Day for dates, everyone is in for a surprise when the guys retain several killer animalistic qualities and start attacking innocent people. After the girls and their dates descend on P3, Phoebe accidentally turns everyone at the club into animals, in an attempt to turn the guys back into their animal forms. As Prue tries to adjust to her free time now that she's unemployed, Piper and Dan have a hard time trying to have a romantic date now that Leo is working at the club.

episodes.title: Pardon My Past
episodes.summary: When an evil presence from Phoebe's past life starts to threaten her with a violent death in the present, she decides to cast a spell to go back to the 1920's and stop him. While there, Phoebe discovers that the Charmed Ones past lives went down the dark path, and as a result, puts her present life on the line in order to change the past and vanquish Anton. Meanwhile, Piper discovers that her present life is similar to her past one, in terms of who to choose in her love life. Prue discovers a new passion.

episodes.title: Give Me a Sign
episodes.summary: When a past love of Prue named Bane Jessup is attacked in prison by an evil demon called Litvack, Bane breaks out of prison and ultimately kidnaps Prue in an attempt to keep the demon from killing him. After Piper and Phoebe catch the couple in a compromising position, Prue convinces her sisters to trust Bane long enough to vanquish the demon. Phoebe decides to help Piper out by casting a spell to help her choose between Leo and Dan, but causes Piper to become more undecided. Prue makes a career decision.

episodes.title: Murphy's Luck
episodes.summary: When Prue gets her first photography assignment, photographing the "unluckiest woman in San Francisco," she unintentionally gets on the bad side of a darklighter when she casts a spell on Maggie Murphy – a future whitelighter. Looking to take his revenge out on Prue by sending her terrifying messages telepathically, Piper and Phoebe are racing against time to save Prue before she takes her own life. Leo then makes a huge sacrifice to stop the darklighter's plan and ultimately gets his wings back.

episodes.title: How to Make a Quilt Out of Americans
episodes.summary: An old friend of Grams comes to see the Halliwell sisters with a dilemma on her hands: she and two other friends apparently summon by accident a demon named Cryto. However, Prue, Piper, and Phoebe soon discover that Gail betrayed them with a promise from the demon of eternal health, beauty and youth. As they plot to get their powers back, Piper announces that she doesn't want them back, fearing that she's missing out on a normal life, but luckily, Prue and Phoebe get her to change her mind. Piper breaks up with Dan.

episodes.title: Chick Flick
episodes.summary: Prue, Piper, and Phoebe battle the Demon of Illusion after he brings to life one of Phoebe's favorite movie characters. Realizing what he can do, the demon sends an axe murder after the sisters in an attempt to kill them. What happens as a result is that the sisters and the demon get drawn into a horror movie where a battle of good and evil ensues before they're able to vanquish the demon.

episodes.title: Ex Libris
episodes.summary: After a classmate of Phoebe is murdered by a demon to stop her thesis proving demons exists from being published, Phoebe and her sisters set out to vanquish the demon called Libris so a past victim can move on to the next plane of existence. However, the ghost is unable to move on until she helps Prue solve the murder of another young woman. Piper's preparation at the club for a performance of the Goo Goo Dolls is cut short when Dan arrives with some surprising news about Leo.

episodes.title: Astral Monkey
episodes.summary: The doctor who treated Piper when she was sick with Oroya fever is trying to figure out how she was able to make complete recovery. As a result, accidentally gains their magical powers from their blood during a test he was conducting. Following this, he starts to use his newfound abilities in an attempt to save his dying sister. However, it doesn't take long for the doctor to go mad from having the sisters' magical powers and they have to find a way to remove them while not bringing any harm to the doctor. Meanwhile, Prue's latest assignment brings some unwanted attention from the paparazzi.

episodes.title: Apocalypse Not
episodes.summary: Prue, Piper, and Phoebe's relaxing night at the club is cut short when they're forced to go up against the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse, who are causing various bouts of road rage in San Francisco. When Prue and Horseman of War are sucked into a vortex that transports them to the Netherworld of Good and Evil, Piper and Phoebe are facing a dilemma of saving Prue or save the world. While attempting to help the sisters out, Leo tries to get his bosses to aid the Charmed Ones and comes across organized evil.

episodes.title: Be Careful What You Witch For
episodes.summary: Tiring of always losing to the Charmed Ones, the Infernal Council decide to send a Genie to destroy them by granting them each a wish. As a result, the sisters soon discover that their wishes come with consequences that could be deadly. It is only after the Genie agrees to undo the wishes do things return to normal that Prue, Piper, and Phoebe are able to vanquish the dragon warlock. To thank the Genie, the sisters agree to grant him a final wish. Piper goes with Leo to meet the Elders.

episodes.title: The Honeymoon's Over
episodes.summary: After being gone with Leo for the past month, Prue and Phoebe wonder if Piper will ever return. While reading through the Book of Shadows, the sisters discover that the ones sending all the demons to attack them are working for a group called the Triad. Later, they come to Darryl's rescue when a mortal man who is protected by a demon tries to kill him. However, the sisters have to lie about to the assistant D.A. Cole Turner in order to keep their secret safe, and as a result, the man is set free. Cole has his own secret that he uses to get rid of the demon. Upon Leo and Piper's return, they realize unless they trick the Elders, they can no longer be together.

episodes.title: Magic Hour
episodes.summary: After discovering that Piper and Leo will have less than 24 hours to get married before the Elders forbid it, they ask for Prue and Phoebe's help in planning and executing the ceremony. However, their plans get put on hold when the Charmed Ones have to help a couple break a jealous sorcerer's curse that keeps them apart. Later, Piper and Leo get some unexpected help in the form of Grams. Meanwhile, Cole continues his quest to get close to the Charmed Ones through a relationship with Phoebe.

episodes.title: Once Upon a Time
episodes.summary: After having a bad dream about Leo, Piper realizes that The Powers That Be have ordered Leo to stay away from her forever. As a result, she goes on a strike from helping Prue and Phoebe save innocents. Meanwhile, Phoebe and Prue try to save a young girl named Kate after trolls start attacking her because she's keeping a fairy safe that they want to harm. Cole continues his quest to get inside the Manor and gain access to the Book of Shadows.

episodes.title: All Halliwell's Eve
episodes.summary: While getting ready for a Halloween party at the club, the sisters soon are sucked through a vortex to 1670 in order to protect their ancestor Charlotte Warren, her unborn child and a coven from an evil witch. Meanwhile, the Grimlocks return and seek revenge on the sisters when they get sent back in time. As a result, Darryl and Leo are stuck battling them while trying to discover what they are in order to vanquish them.

episodes.title: Sight Unseen
episodes.summary: After the manor gets burglarized, Piper and Phoebe become concerned that Prue is becoming obsessed with learning everything about the Evil Triad sending demons to destroy them. When Darryl comes to investigate the break-in, he tries to convince Prue that it was the work of human thieves, but she's certain that the suspect is supernatural. Upon meeting with the Triad, Cole is upset that his bosses are sending another demon to try and destroy the Charmed Ones, despite his assurance he'll destroy them on his own. Meanwhile, Piper is certain that Leo's bosses are behind another ruined attempt of having a normal, romantic date.

episodes.title: Primrose Empath
episodes.summary: When Cole casts a spell on Prue to make her think that a man is suffering because he can feel the pain of others, she decides to cast a spell of her own to remove the man's empathic powers, only to unwitting release a demon from a curse and causes the demon to harm innocents again. As the demon decides to hunt the person who cursed him, Prue soon discovers that in removing the empathic power from the demon caused her to gain it instead. While Phoebe starts to fall head over heels for Cole, Piper fears that her relationship with Leo doesn't fall into the realm of being normal.

episodes.title: Power Outage
episodes.summary: Cole's latest plan to take down the Charmed Ones involve having an anger demon cast a spell on the sisters that causes petty anger to render them powerless if other demons cross their path. However, his growing love for Phoebe causes Cole to be an obstacle in seeing his plan through, especially after the Triad finds out. Leo urges the sisters to make up in order to get the power of three back to fight Beltazor.

episodes.title: Sleuthing with the Enemy
episodes.summary: After Cole mysteriously leaves following the Charmed Ones fought off Belthazor, Phoebe starts to worry and wonder what has happened to him. As the sisters begin mixing the potion that they plan on using to destroy Belthazor, they get an unexpected visitor: a demon bounty hunter called Krell. When he tells them that he was sent by the Source to destroy Belthazor, Prue and Piper readily agree to help him out, while Phoebe is preoccupied by her worry for Cole. Later, the sisters are surprised to discover Cole's identity and as a result, Phoebe is conflicted whether she should help vanquish Belthazor or let him escape.

episodes.title: Coyote Piper
episodes.summary: Piper is reluctant to go to her high school's 10th reunion, despite the facts she's now a successful business owner and that the reunion will be held at her club. Things get complicated when an alchemist accidentally sets free an evil spirt that eventually possesses Piper as she is getting ready for the reunion. As a result, Prue and Phoebe have their hands full trying to get Piper back to normal. Meanwhile Phoebe tries to get some answers about Cole's past.

episodes.title: We All Scream for Ice Cream
episodes.summary: After having a song stuck in her head for a while, Prue eventually realizes it belongs to an ice cream truck. When she and Phoebe get sucked through a vortex into the van, they discover several children stuck inside and take it upon themselves to save them. However, the sisters soon discover that the children are demonic. Phoebe soon has a premonition where she see that as a child, Prue was sucked into the same van, only to be saved by their father. As a result, they have to call upon their father for help.

episodes.title: Blinded by the Whitelighter
episodes.summary: An evil demon named Eames has been killing good witches and their whitelighters in order to obtain their powers. After Eames kills his latest victim, her whitelighter Natalie comes to help Leo protect Prue, Piper, and Phoebe. Due to Natalie's insistence that things be done by the book, she constantly butts heads with the sisters, and that eventually has some dire consequences for the whitelighter. As a result, they go about vanquishing Eames their own way. Meanwhile, Phoebe shares a big secret about Cole with Leo.

episodes.title: Wrestling with Demons
episodes.summary: When Phoebe has a premonition about a demon attacking a young man named Tom, Prue is surprised to find that the intended victim is an old boyfriend of hers. The sisters soon discover that the demon is posing as a sports agent and that Tom is his latest recruit for his demon academy, where the recruits shed the last of their humanity and become demons. Not wanting to lose Tom, Prue agrees that she and her sisters will fight in an underworld wrestling ring to save his soul. Meanwhile, Phoebe tries to find the best way to tell her sisters about Cole.

episodes.title: Bride and Gloom
episodes.summary: A demon tricks Prue into marrying him, with the hope that he'll turn her, Piper, and Phoebe evil and ultimately cause the Book of Shadows to flow towards evil magic. When Piper and Phoebe discover this, Phoebe turns to a recently returned Cole for help in saving Prue before it's too late.

episodes.title: The Good, the Bad and the Cursed
episodes.summary: After visiting a deserted old ghost town with her father, Phoebe begins to have visions of an American-Indian getting beaten up by a local thug and soon starts receiving the same injuries as the man. When Prue and Piper realize that Phoebe is caught up in a time loop of that town, Prue has to go there and with the help of Cole, save Phoebe and the man before the thug kills them and break the loop.

episodes.title: Just Harried
episodes.summary: On the day of Piper's marriage to Leo, Prue's Astrally Projected-self adopts an uninhibited, wild personality that threatens to ruin the wedding and place Prue in jail for Murder.

episodes.title: Death Takes a Halliwell
episodes.summary: As the sisters enjoy some free time at the beach, Prue notices a woman with an odd shadow nearby taking pictures of them. Later, Prue discovers the woman is the partner of the investigator looking for Cole. Meanwhile, Cole is being chased by a pair of demons and fears for Phoebe's safety. While this is going on, Prue gets in a battle with the Angel of Death and ultimately has to come to terms with her mother dying so young.

episodes.title: Pre-Witched
episodes.summary: Looking for a little privacy now that they're married, Piper and Leo decide to move out on their own. As a result, the sisters have to come to terms with how things now are, and then they reminisce about how things were after Grams died and when Phoebe moved to New York. As they're dealing with the possibility of Piper's possible move, the sisters have to battle a warlock who was a former cat multiple times before being able to vanquish him before he turns immortal.

episodes.title: Sin Francisco
episodes.summary: Leo and the sisters become targeted by a demon who has access to the seven deadly sins. After they each get infected with the sins, they must find a way to break the hold the sins have on them before getting destroyed by the demon so he can get their souls.

episodes.title: The Demon Who Came in from the Cold
episodes.summary: Cole officially aligns himself with Phoebe and her sisters when he agrees to go undercover as Belthazor in order to investigate an evil organization who are murdering street prophets in order to promote their own internet provider. Things get tricky when the sisters have to vanquish the demon who is posing as the company's manager without getting Cole into trouble. However, the sisters soon fear that Cole may be double-crossing them.

episodes.title: Exit Strategy
episodes.summary: In order to prove that he's still committed to his demonic ways, the Brotherhood has Cole steal an amulet that belongs to a witch that will help protect him from the Charmed Ones. However, the only way to get it is if Cole kills the witch, which will cause Phoebe to turn her back on him. Meanwhile, as Piper and Leo prepare to go on their honeymoon, she discovers she has a new power and has trouble controlling it.

episodes.title: Look Who's Barking
episodes.summary: As she is adding to the Belthazor section of the Book of Shadows, Phoebe has a premonition about a Banshee targeting innocents who are grieving, causing her to suspect that Cole is behind it. Looking to find the Banshee before she causes any harm, the sisters cast a spell to track her down, resulting in Prue being turned into a dog. When Prue gets hit by a car while in dog form, a remorseful Phoebe gets turned into a banshee herself when she gets attacked by the evil witch. Looking to relieve Phoebe from her pain, she goes to Belthazor and urges him to help save Phoebe before it's too late for her. Piper continues trying to get a handle on her new powers.

episodes.title: All Hell Breaks Loose
episodes.summary: After the sisters save a doctor from the Source's personal hitman, they're exposed as witches. As a result, Phoebe and Cole get trapped in the Underworld, where they reluctantly make an agreement with the Tempus to go back in time to before the sisters' secret is exposed. However, that causes Phoebe, Cole, and Leo to be stuck in the Underworld while Prue and Piper get sent back in time and get caught in a life or death situation while Phoebe is forced to make a difficult decision to stay where she is or to go help save innocents and her sisters.

episodes.title: Charmed Again, Part 1
episodes.summary: While struggling with the grief of losing Prue, Piper and Phoebe mourn over the loss of the power of three. However, when Piper tries to contact Prue using the Book of Shadows, she and Phoebe discover that they have a half-sister named Paige. It doesn't take long for the Source to learn of Paige as well, and tries to kill her before restoring the Power of Three.

episodes.title: Charmed Again, Part 2
episodes.summary: After the sisters vanquish Shax, The Source of All Evil decides to turn Paige evil instead of killing her. As a result, the Source possesses her boyfriend to see if he can lure her to the dark side. Upon learning of the Source's plan, Piper and Phoebe do their best to track Paige down and convince her to fulfill her destiny to become a Charmed One. As this is occurring, Paige is discovering what her powers can do. Inspector Cortez suspects Piper and Phoebe are behind the deaths of Prue and Dr. Griffiths.

episodes.title: Hell Hath No Fury
episodes.summary: Still angered over Prue's death, Piper goes on a demon vanquishing rampage, ultimately putting Phoebe, Cole, and herself at risk. As they fight the demons called The Furies, Piper accidentally inhales some smoke that was released by the demons, resulting in her anger magnifying and becoming a Fury herself. It is only after going to Prue's grave is she able to let go of her anger. Meanwhile, Paige steals the Book of Shadows and uses it for her own personal gain at work after she and some co-workers get harassed by a boss.

episodes.title: Enter the Demon
episodes.summary: While busy studying the Book of Shadows, Paige shows a large amount of jealously in how adept Phoebe is while performing her martial arts. As a result, when Paige mixes a potion, she accidentally swaps bodies with Phoebe, and while they try to hide the mix-up from Piper, they have a hard time doing so when the sisters have to go help a Zen Master save her kidnapped father from Limbo.

episodes.title: Size Matters
episodes.summary: Paige starts having a bad feeling about a nearby house but is less than happy when Piper and Phoebe are hesitant to go investigate it. Later, with Leo's help, Paige is able to get Phoebe to go investigate – where Phoebe ultimately gets kidnapped and shrunken into a figurine by a demon called Gammill. When he discovers that his latest victim is a Charmed One, Gammill sets his sights on kidnapping Piper and Paige. Meanwhile, Piper decides to hire a concert promoter for P3, and when he starts making drastic changes, things do go as she hoped.

episodes.title: A Knight to Remember
episodes.summary: When Paige has a fairytale stuck in her head, she decides to use her magic and a special spell to bring to life a Prince from a favorite fairy tale that occurred in a past life. Little does she realize is that an evil version of herself also comes out of the story in order to get to take the Prince back and change history. While the Charmed Ones try to keep the evil enchantress at bay, they also have deal with a Shocker Demon attacking the manor.

episodes.title: Brain Drain
episodes.summary: After being attacked by a chameleon sent to the manor by the Source, Piper is put into a coma, where she is forced to live in an alternate reality. Before the Source is able to tap into her brain in order to drain her of her power, Phoebe, Paige, Leo, and Cole go through some drastic measures to save Piper by breaking the Source's hold on her.

episodes.title: Black as Cole
episodes.summary: After pondering a marriage proposal from Cole, Phoebe is forced to face a blast from his demonic past when the widow of one of his past victims hunts him down, looking for vengeance. As a result, they're forced to face an old protégé of Belthazor's who likes to kill witches with the same athame Cole used to use. However, when Paige learns of this, she has an instant mistrust of Cole and tries to convince her sisters to vanquish him. Meanwhile, Paige helps Leo and Piper find out whether they're ready to have kids.

episodes.title: Muse to My Ears
episodes.summary: Piper, Phoebe, and Paige learn that a warlock is in the process of kidnapping and enslaving the muses inside a special ring in order to make the forces of evil more powerful. As a result, they have to find a way to save the remaining ones and rescue the others before the warlock's plan comes to fruition. Meanwhile, Cole starts to get frustrated that Phoebe has so far spurning his marriage proposal and is worried that without his demonic powers, he'll be unable to help keep her safe from the demon factions who plan on attacking the Charmed Ones.

episodes.title: A Paige from the Past
episodes.summary: Still feeling guilty about her adoptive parents' death, Paige gets some help from Leo and the ghosts to go back to the day of their car accident so can work through her feelings and discovers how she was able to live through the accident. Meanwhile, Phoebe and Cole get possessed by a pair of ghosts who look to finish a job from 50 years ago, and as a result, Piper has to find a way to keep the ghosts in succeeding in their mission.

episodes.title: Trial by Magic
episodes.summary: Phoebe is selected to serve on the jury of a man on trial for murder. During the case, she has a premonition showing someone else committing the crime, despite the evidence against the defendant. While Leo, Piper and Paige rush to find the rightful killer and bring him to justice, Phoebe does her best to stall her fellow jurors from finding the man guilty. Meanwhile, Paige's friend Glen is in town and Paige invites him to stay at the manor. While there, he discovers the Book of Secrets and soon finds out Paige's magical powers.

episodes.title: Lost and Bound
episodes.summary: While at work, Paige discovers that a 10 year-old boy in foster care has the ability to magically start fires. Upon learning that his foster parents are actually demons who are attempting to get him to use his powers for evil, she, Piper, and Phoebe try to convince him to use his powers for good. Meanwhile, Cole proposes to Phoebe now that they are no longer possessed by spirits. However, when she puts on Grams' engagement ring, she falls under its magical spell and turns into a 1950's housewife. Also, Cole goes to work with Paige at the social services office.

episodes.title: Charmed and Dangerous
episodes.summary: When the Seer discovers that the Source will be destroyed by the Charmed Ones, he breaks a centuries old agreement between good and evil when he steals the Hollow, an ancient vapor, which he uses to steal Piper and Paige's powers. As this transpires, Phoebe has to work with Cole, despite having a premonition where she sees him sacrificing himself to save her from a demon. Meanwhile, there's more to Phoebe's premonition than meets the eye.

episodes.title: The Three Faces of Phoebe
episodes.summary: After getting a case of cold feet about marrying Cole, Phoebe decides to cast a spell where she brings her future, cynical self and herself when she was an innocent child to the present in order to gain some guidance as to what she should do. Meanwhile, Cole gets possessed by the Source and eventually becomes unable to resist doing his bidding. An evil demon called Kurzon attempts to align with the Seer to become the next Source and is sent on a mission to destroy the Power of Three. At work, Paige gets promoted to a social worker. However, worried that what she did in order to be promoted could be seen as a personal gain, she attempts to make things right with her co-worker that was passed up for the job.

episodes.title: Marry-Go-Round
episodes.summary: When the Seer has a vision that Cole and Phoebe's son will be the most powerful being to live, she informs the Source of this. As a result, Cole begins to sabotage Phoebe's plans of having a white wedding, so they can get married in a dark ceremony.

episodes.title: The Fifth Halliwheel
episodes.summary: As Piper and Phoebe begin gushing about how great married life is, Paige starts to feel left out, resulting in her suspicions of Cole being a demon again starting to grow. Meanwhile, the Seer gives Cole a special tonic that cause Phoebe to get pregnant as soon as possible.

episodes.title: Saving Private Leo
episodes.summary: When a pair of brothers who served in World War 2 with Leo return and seek revenge on Leo for their deaths, he has no choice to do what they want before the brothers hurt everyone he loves. Cole begins to plot with the Seer and a new demonic assistant to find a way to get Phoebe to move out of the Manor and into their own place in order to break the Power of Three.

episodes.title: Bite Me
episodes.summary: When Cole attempts to unite the underworld before his coronation as the Source, a group of exiled vampires take it upon themselves to kidnap Paige, in an attempt to turn her and as a result, her sisters, vampires so they can claim the evil underworld throne as their own with the help of the Charmed Ones. However, when Cole learns of their plans, he orders that all vampires be killed, and as a result, Paige's life hangs in the balance.

episodes.title: We're Off to See the Wizard
episodes.summary: After Phoebe tells Piper and Paige that she's pregnant with Cole's child, they team up with a wizard in an attempt to stop the Source before he ascends to power. However, they are unaware that Cole is now the new Source and that once his coronation takes place, Phoebe will take her place as the new Queen of the Underworld.

episodes.title: Long Live the Queen
episodes.summary: Irritated over the fact that Cole has been ignoring her now that he's the Source, Phoebe destroys several of his demons over the course of a couple days. It is at this time when she has a premonition about an innocent that will soon perish at the hands of a demon, and as a result, she goes to the manor to warn Piper and Paige. When Cole discovers what she has done, Phoebe has to choose which side she has to fight for: good or evil.

episodes.title: Womb Raider
episodes.summary: After banishing Cole, Phoebe's baby begins having strong demonic powers while still in the womb. As a result, the baby starts signs of open hostility toward Paige and anyone else who speaks ill of his father. What happens next is that the Seer takes it upon herself to steal the demonic baby from Phoebe and ultimately gain its power as heir to the Source.

episodes.title: Witch Way Now?
episodes.summary: Following the defeat of the Source, Piper, Phoebe, and Paige are visited by the Angel of Destiny with a tempting reward: continue their lives as the Charmed Ones or relinquish their powers and live normal lives. Their decision however, is put on hold when the sisters discover that they're being investigated by the FBI because of their involvement with a large number of unsolved cases. Meanwhile, Cole is trying to reach out to Phoebe. Later, after the sisters make their decision, Piper and Leo get some miraculous news.

episodes.title: A Witch's Tail, Part 1
episodes.summary: After Mylie, a mermaid turned human makes a deal with a sea-hag, she turns to Piper, Phoebe, and Paige after their pact turns out bad. As a result of the sisters' helping her out, Phoebe gets turned into a mermaid. Meanwhile, as this is playing out, Phoebe's divorce of Cole gets put on hold when he returns, begging her to take him back. Cole then decides to help Daryl out in an attempt to get back on Phoebe's good side. As Paige struggles to find a balance between her work as a Charmed One and a Social Worker, Piper struggles to face her fears of a water demon.

episodes.title: A Witch's Tail, Part 2
episodes.summary: Piper, Leo, and Paige try their best to convince Phoebe to return to her life as a Charmed One, only to be surprised when she swims away instead of dealing with her feelings toward Cole. As a result, Paige turns to Cole for help in getting Phoebe back to her normal self. Piper however, decides to use magic to deal with her panic attacks, and as a result, has to deal with Necron comes to kidnap Phoebe in her mermaid form, only to be kidnapped herself.

episodes.title: Happily Ever After
episodes.summary: A wicked witch breaks free of the confines of the mirror after she kills the Keeper of the Fairy Tales and sets her sights on destroying Piper, Phoebe, and Paige. As a result, Piper and Grams fall victims to Wolf from Little Red Riding Hood, Phoebe to the glass slippers found in Cinderella, and Paige to the poison apple from Snow White. It takes Cole and Leo working together to find a way to vanquish the wicked witch, break the evil spell over the fairy tales, save the sisters, and set the fairy tales back to how they were originally written.

episodes.title: Siren Song
episodes.summary: A Siren arrives in San Francisco, looking to cause trouble for couples. After she kills the husband of a future Whitelighter, she sets her sights on Phoebe and Cole, Piper and Paige have to find a way to keep them from dying. That proves to be tricky when, following an argument between Leo and Piper, their unborn baby uses its magic to make them swap powers, in an attempt to walk a mile in one another's shoes. Cole continues in his quest to prove to Phoebe that he's no longer evil.

episodes.title: Witches in Tights
episodes.summary: Kevin is a young witch who can bring his drawings to life. When a demon learns of his powers, he turns to Kevin, looking to turn into an evil Supervillain in order to kill a retiring Elder before he names a replacement. However, before the demon gets his hands on the young witch, he works his magic on the Charmed Ones and turns them into Superheroes. With all the superpowers raining down upon San Francisco, Piper, Phoebe, and Paige have their work cut out for them after being tasked to protect the retiring Elder.

episodes.title: The Eyes Have It
episodes.summary: After a Gypsy hunter begins hunting gypsies in order to find a pair of eyes for his father, who was blinded by one years ago to regain his sight, the Charmed Ones have to find a way to save them, especially after a fortune teller from a gypsy family is found slaughtered.

episodes.title: Sympathy for the Demon
episodes.summary: When Barbas, the Demon of Fear, makes a return into the Charmed Ones lives, he tricks Paige and Cole into giving him the powers Cole obtained while in the Wastelands so he can use them to turn the sisters' greatest fears against them.

episodes.title: A Witch in Time
episodes.summary: When Phoebe gets a premonition that her new boyfriend Miles will die at the hands of a demon, she takes it upon herself to be his bodyguard around the clock. However, she becomes disheartened that she continually gets that same premonition several more times. As a result, she inadvertently opens a portal where a demon from the future gets in contact with Cole, who tries to stop Phoebe from getting in the way of Miles' destiny.

episodes.title: Sam I Am
episodes.summary: When Paige begins working as a Whitelighter, she is floored to discover that her first charge is her father Sam. Meanwhile, Cole finally realizes that he and Phoebe will not get back together that he devises a plan to fill Phoebe, Piper, and Paige with hate that they won't think twice about vanquishing him, and teams up with a demon who has plans for Paige's father to get their plot started.

episodes.title: Y Tu Mummy También
episodes.summary: When Phoebe falls prey to a demon named Jeric, who is kidnapping witches in order to find the perfect host body for his love, Isis, Cole decides to attempt to make a trade: Paige's body in exchange for Phoebe being returned safely. However, thanks to Cole's decision, Piper is able to trick Jeric in order to save both of her sisters in order to banish the demon. It is only after Cole realizes he has failed to destroy the Power of Three, he promises the sisters the next time they meet, he won't fail.

episodes.title: The Importance of Being Phoebe
episodes.summary: In an attempt to gain control of the Manor and the Nexus, Cole decides to try to take down Piper, Phoebe, and Paige through legal means: Piper through a failed health inspection at P3, arresting Paige, and using a shapeshifter to take over the life of Phoebe. When a demon who is working with Cole accidentally tells the real Phoebe about Cole's plan, the sisters go about finding a way to defeat Cole.

episodes.title: Centennial Charmed
episodes.summary: After acquiring new powers from a celestial being, Cole decides to use them to attempt to destroy the Charmed Ones one last time by altering reality. As a result, Paige is erased from existence of her sisters, Phoebe is living the high life as Cole's wife even though she doesn't love him, and Piper is on a demon hunting frenzy to avenge Prue's death and is no longer married to Leo. When Paige tries to reconstruct the Power of Three in order to vanquish Cole, Phoebe is the one who actually vanquishes him, and as a result, all of Cole's spell on the Charmed Ones is undone with one drawback: Paige is the only one who remembers what happened.

episodes.title: House Call
episodes.summary: Tiring of the leftover demonic energy at the Manor, the sisters decide to call upon a Witch Doctor to cleanse their home. However, the Witch Doctor believes the sisters are evil, and as a result, puts a hex on them. As a result, Piper becomes obsessed with cleaning, Phoebe is obsessed with getting rid of her competition at the newspaper, and Paige becomes with loving her friend Glenn. When it appears that the sisters are about to die as a result of the hex, the Witch Doctor's leader makes him realize what a grave mistake he made.

episodes.title: Sand Francisco Dreamin'
episodes.summary: The sisters and Leo must fight their nightmares come to life after a demon attacks them with some magical sand that was stolen from a sandman. Piper, Phoebe, and Paige soon realize in order to defeat and vanquish the demon is by confronting what's worrying them in their dreams and ultimately saving the sandman from certain death. Afterwards, Leo feels closer to the baby after feeling it kick.

episodes.title: The Day the Magic Died
episodes.summary: The aurora borealis is happening and as result, nothing magical is able to occur around the world. As a result, a powerful sorcerer called Cronyn decides to use that to his advantage in order to take out the Charmed Ones before Piper can deliver her baby. However, Phoebe and Paige set up a summit in an attempt to get things back to normal, leaving Leo to try and keep them safe. Meanwhile, Victor and his new wife arrive and help Piper deliver her baby, however, they're in for a surprise at discovering Doris being a demon, trying to steal the new bundle of joy in the Halliwell house.

episodes.title: Baby's First Demon
episodes.summary: After discovering that a pair of demons is out to kidnap Piper and Leo's son, they set out to protect him. However, everyone is surprised to see that the baby has a few tricks up his sleeves to help keep himself safe. Meanwhile, as they try to discover who is trying to take the baby and why, Paige decides to go undercover as a bounty hunter to find that out. Because the newspaper was sold, Phoebe finds herself at odds with the new owner.

episodes.title: Lucky Charmed
episodes.summary: After Leprechauns are being killed by a demon looking to use their luck to aid other demons in gaining power in the Underworld. Realizing that there's a target on their backs, the remaining Leprechauns grant the Charmed Ones good luck, in an attempt to vanquish the demon and stay alive.

episodes.title: Cat House
episodes.summary: Having numerous marital problems, Piper and Leo turn to a marriage counselor for help. After getting advice to talk about their memories in order to remember how things have been, Piper decides to cast a spell to relive their past, and happens to get Phoebe, Paige, their cat Kit, and a demon caught up in the spell. As Leo and Piper work through their problems, Phoebe and Paige try to figure out what happen while keeping themselves safe.

episodes.title: Nymphs Just Want to Have Fun
episodes.summary: A pair of demons seek revenge on trio of wood nymphs, and as a result, kill their Satyr. Unable to agree on how to proceed with their revenge, one demon tricks the nymphs into thinking he is their new leader, and the other kills one of the nymphs. As the remaining nymphs flee, they decide Paige will be a suitable replacement and turn her into one of them, resulting in Piper and Phoebe trying to find a way to save the nymphs and turn Paige back to normal.

episodes.title: Sense and Sense Ability
episodes.summary: The Crone devises a plot to steal the sisters' senses in an attempt to get at Wyatt in order to see what the future has in store for him. As a result, she turns to an old demon that the sister previously faced and ultimately vanquished for help.

episodes.title: Necromancing the Stone
episodes.summary: When Grams comes to the manor for a Wiccan birthing ceremony, for Wyatt, the sisters find out that she has brought a memory from her past, a former lover who wants to kill the Charmed Ones and bring back the love they once shared. Meanwhile, Phoebe contemplates Jason's invitation, even though it will take her away from her family, and Paige casts a truth spell to figure out if Nate can accept her being a witch.

episodes.title: Oh My Goddess (1)
episodes.summary: When a pair of Titan Gods are released from captivity, they go after and ultimately kill the Elders, resulting in Leo to be promoted to the job. As Piper, Phoebe, and Paige try to help figure out what happened and ultimately vanquish the Titans, a whitelighter from the future arrives to help and gives them a way to stop the Titans – by turning the Charmed Ones into Goddesses.

episodes.title: Oh My Goddess (2)
episodes.summary: In part 2 of the season 6 finale, Leo turns Piper, Phoebe, and Paige into Goddesses in order to stop the Titans and restore the balance in the Universe. However, the sisters are having a hard time trying to figure out how to do so with their new, enhanced, powers and without Leo's assistance. Upon learning that Leo is becoming an Elder, Piper's fury helps the Charmed Ones ultimately defeat the Titans.

episodes.title: Valhalley of the Dolls, Part 1
episodes.summary: With Leo's promotion to Elder leaving Piper in a surprisingly happy mood, Paige decides to cast a spell on her to see if she's really as good about the changes in their lives as she claims to be. However, the spell backfires and leaves Piper with amnesia. Needing Leo's help to reverse things, the sisters soon discover that he's being held captive by warrior maidens and they take it upon themselves to go save them. Phoebe gains the power of empathy.

episodes.title: Valhalley of the Dolls, Part 2
episodes.summary: After Piper's memories return, she refuses to leave the Island of Valhalla and stays with the Valkyries while the others return home. Phoebe and Paige have to deal with the warriors who followed them back without the help of the Power of Three. After the warriors start attacking innocents across San Francisco, Piper and the other Valkyries arrive to try to stop the attacks. Upon learning of Phoebe's new power, Leo urges her to use it to try and turn Piper back. With the help of the other Elders, Leo tries to discover who sent him to Valhalla.

episodes.title: Forget Me... Not
episodes.summary: Wyatt accidently brings a dragon to life, and as a result, the Cleaners arrive to make sure the baby's actions don't cause magic to be exposed as real. However, when the Cleaners try to make Wyatt disappear from the Charmed Ones lives, Piper, Phoebe, and Paige have their work cut out for them when they try to get him back.

episodes.title: The Power of Three Blondes
episodes.summary: After Piper, Phoebe, and Paige have their identities and powers stolen by three evil sisters, they have their work cut out when they have to prove to Chris they're really themselves and to vanquish the fake Charmed Ones.

episodes.title: Love's a Witch
episodes.summary: While working on her recent temp job, Paige becomes involved in a feud between two magical families when a diseased lover possesses her. As she tries to settle the hostilities between the families, Leo becomes suspicious of Chris' intentions toward his interactions with Piper, Phoebe, and Paige. Chris tries to keep a secret from Phoebe and her empath powers.

episodes.title: My Three Witches
episodes.summary: In order to get Piper, Phoebe, and Paige to concentrate more on their magical duties, Chris conspires with a demon, who, ultimately casts a spell on them where they are sent to an alternate reality where their desires come true. While the sisters are caught in their alternate realities, Leo confronts Chris about the Valkyries and threatens to talk to the other elders about clipping his wings for his killing of one in order to get her pendant. Meanwhile, Leo and Piper disagree over how to care for a sick Wyatt.

episodes.title: Soul Survivor
episodes.summary: After seeing her new boss die by the hands of a demon right in front of her, Paige discovers that he sold his soul to that demon and the demon was just collecting the debt. However, when she tells Piper and Phoebe about what happened, Paige is disappointed when they tell her not to go after the demon to save him, and as a result, ignores their advice and makes a huge sacrifice in order to save her boss.

episodes.title: Sword and the City
episodes.summary: When the Lady of the Lake arrives at the Manor, looking for help in protecting Excalibur from several axe wielding demons, the sisters gain some assistance from several magical beings. However, when Piper accidentally pulls out the Sword in the Stone, everyone worries that the power of wielding the sword might go to her head.

episodes.title: Little Monsters
episodes.summary: After the sisters kill a Manticore, they soon discover that it was a mother when they find its baby. As a result, they soon find themselves taking the baby in and promptly begin to wonder if they could raise the half demon child to be a force for good instead of evil. Meanwhile, Piper, Phoebe, Paige, and Leo have to find a way to help Darryl after he obtains magical powers.

episodes.title: Chris-Crossed
episodes.summary: When Chris' girlfriend from the future comes to bring him back to the future and steal his white-lighter powers, the Charmed Ones discover the reason why he came to change the past. As a result, they have to race against time to get him back to the present and keep him safe.

episodes.title: Witchstock
episodes.summary: When Paige finds an old pair of go-go boots that Grams owned, she gets transported back to 1967. Upon arriving there, Paige discovers she fits right in, since magic is practice freely and that was a dream of hers. However, Piper and Phoebe have their work cut out when they try to find a way to keep Paige from changing their timeline, only to discover they're the ones that cause damage in the past.

episodes.title: Prince Charmed
episodes.summary: When Piper gives up on finding Mr. Right, she becomes extremely overprotective of Wyatt. As a result, Phoebe and Paige become worried and as result, decide to create a potion to create the perfect guy and decide to give Piper "Mr. Right" as a birthday present, hoping to get her to remember how important love is. Meanwhile, Chris and Leo try to keep Wyatt safe from a demonic cult called "the Order" after they flip Wyatt's sense of morality.

episodes.title: Used Karma
episodes.summary: When Paige's boyfriend Richard casts a spell to rid himself of negative karma, it backfires when Phoebe get possessed by the spirit of Mata Hari, bad karma and all. As a result, when the sisters orb back to the manor after fighting a demon, Jason finally discovers Phoebe's secret. It is only after Richard makes a potion for Jason to give to Phoebe to reverse the spell and then talk about her secret and the couple ultimately decide to take a break.

episodes.title: The Legend of Sleepy Halliwell
episodes.summary: When a mentor of Leo's arrives at the Manor with news that a student conjured up a headless horseman and is ultimately terrorizing students and teachers alike at Magic School, the sisters are surprised to learn about the supernatural institution of learning all things magic. They are soon asked to help discover why a student called upon the horseman and stop him before escaping to hurt innocents. Meanwhile while on a vision quest, Phoebe learns something shocking about Chris.

episodes.title: I Dream of Phoebe
episodes.summary: When Phoebe becomes a genie after accidentally being tricked to grant the current genie in the bottle her freedom, Chris tries to get her to grant his wish to get Leo and Piper back together before he ceases to exist. Things end between Richard and Paige after she helps him strip him of his magical powers.

episodes.title: The Courtship of Wyatt's Father
episodes.summary: As the family celebrate Wyatt's first birthday, a darklighter arrives at the manor, seeking to kill Leo accidentally sends him and Piper to another plane of existence, Phoebe and Paige mourn their apparent deaths, and Chris is in danger of vanishing forever.

episodes.title: Hyde School Reunion
episodes.summary: It's Phoebe's high school reunion and Paige plans on tagging along with her to the big party. However, as Paige looks through Phoebe's yearbook, she sees a side of Phoebe she's never seen before and decides to cast a spell to help her through the night and ultimately doesn't turn out as she hoped. Meanwhile at the Manor, Piper calls Victor for help in trying to find out why Chris is being so distant now that she's pregnant.

episodes.title: Spin City
episodes.summary: When Piper is kidnapped by a Spider Demon, a creature that captures and feeds off magical being every hundred years, Chris gets infected by its venom and ultimately gets turned into a spider himself. Meanwhile, Leo learns that Piper is pregnant and that the baby will grow up to become Chris. The family discovers why Chris is so hostile toward Leo.

episodes.title: Crimes and Witch-Demeanors
episodes.summary: When the sisters are caught on tape using their magical powers, Darryl faces the brunt of the consequences when he gets implicated in a murder after the Cleaners arrive to take care of the mess. As a result, Piper, Phoebe, and Paige go on trial where there is a distinct possibility where they are stripped of their powers.

episodes.title: A Wrong Day's Journey Into Right
episodes.summary: After Paige unknowingly conjures up the evil twin of Mr. Right to help relieve some of her stress, he tricks her into thinking she has to eliminate Piper and Phoebe in order to fulfil her secret desire. Meanwhile, a demon finds a way to use the sister's spells to vanquish his competition. As a result, the sisters have to investigate whether that has to do with Paige's spell.

episodes.title: Witch Wars
episodes.summary: A trio of demons conspire to lure Piper, Phoebe, and Paige onto a demonic reality show where the contestants are competing to hunt down the sisters and the winner gets the Charmed Ones magical powers. Meanwhile, Phoebe gets closer to the one who turns Wyatt evil in the future.

episodes.title: It's a Bad, Bad, Bad, Bad World, Part 1
episodes.summary: When Chris and Leo enter a parallel world where evil reigns, Phoebe and Paige lead the charge to save them from their evil counterparts. It is here where the identity of who turns Wyatt evil is revealed.

episodes.title: It's a Bad, Bad, Bad, Bad World, Part 2
episodes.summary: As Piper goes into labor, Phoebe and Paige attempt to put things back in order and stop Gideon from turning Wyatt evil. However, Leo is less than thrilled when the other Elders tell him not to go after Gideon on his own, especially after Gideon decided to team up with Barbas to get the job done. Ultimately, Leo is able to team up with his evil parallel counterpart go against Gideon with explosive results.

episodes.title: A Call to Arms
episodes.summary: Leo searches for Barbas, intent on finding him and making him pay for teaming up with Gideon. However, when Barbas learns of Leo's intention, he plans on using Leo's rage to his advantage. Meanwhile, Leo and Piper accidentally obtain the powers of Hindu God, resulting in Phoebe and Paige attempting to reverse the spell before the universe is destroyed. Phoebe decides to take a brief sabbatical from her column.

episodes.title: The Bare Witch Project
episodes.summary: Paige's pitch to keep Magic School open hits a snag when a student inadvertently summons Lady Godiva to its halls. When the sisters are tasked to send her back to where she came from, things get tricky when an evil land baron arrives with the intent of killing her before going on her rather infamous ride. Phoebe has a hard time letting go while on her sabbatical.

episodes.title: Cheaper by the Coven
episodes.summary: After calling upon Grams for Chris' wiccaning, she quickly grows tired of Wyatt and Chris' constant bickering and sibling rivalry, and casts a spell to put an end to it. However, her spells moves the bickering to the closest siblings in the area: Piper, Phoebe and Paige. As a result, the sisters revert to their teenage ways and cause Grams and Victor to find a way to rapidly reverse the spell, especially after a demon attacked Wyatt.

episodes.title: Charrrmed!
episodes.summary: After Paige crosses paths with a cursed pirate called Captain Black Jack Cutting, she happens to get cursed as well and begins to rapidly age. As a result, Piper and Phoebe have to find and steal a special golden chalice for Paige to use to drink from the fountain of youth in order to break the curse.

episodes.title: Styx Feet Under
episodes.summary: After discovering that a demon is trying to rid himself of his humanity by killing all his remaining human family, Paige decides to cast a spell from all forms of death from happening. As a result, the Angel of Death forces Piper to help right what happened and return order to the world by turning her into a collector of souls.

episodes.title: Once in a Blue Moon
episodes.summary: The sisters get assigned a new Whitelighter as a blue moon rises over San Francisco. When the moon causes the Charmed Ones magic to transform into something unusual, their Whitelighter get mauled, causing the Elders to cast suspicion upon Leo. However, they soon discover what the moon has done to their powers and go about fixing everything. Meanwhile, Leo has an interesting encounter with the Avatars.

episodes.title: Someone to Witch Over Me
episodes.summary: When Phoebe encourages Leo to go on a vision quest to go over the important moments in his life and afterlife, he is thrown for a loop upon discovering that future Chris is his spirit guide. Meanwhile, Paige agrees to help Agent Brody go after the demons who killed his family, and as a result, they have to go up against a powerful demon called Sarpedon, who captures innocents' Guardian Angels to use for his own protection. When Piper and Phoebe's lives hang in the balance, Leo learns he has the power to save them, only if he agrees to help the Avatars.

episodes.title: Charmed Noir
episodes.summary: When a murder occurs at Magic School, Paige and Agent Brody get sucked into an unfinished gangster novel during their investigation. However, their only hope for getting back into the real world is to find the author of the story and get the story finished. As the pair work on their adventure in the pages of the book, Piper, Leo, and Phoebe work on trying to finish the story themselves to bring Paige and Brody back to the present before they're killed by the story's criminal element.

episodes.title: There's Something About Leo
episodes.summary: With Piper, Phoebe, and Paige's suspicions that something is wrong increasing, Leo decides to tell Piper that he has become an avatar. After doing so, pandemonium occurs when a demonic gang decides to put the Charmed Ones on the trail of their rivals that causes the sisters to ultimately lose an innocent through the course of battle. However, time gets reset and Piper is unable to remember Leo telling her his secret. Kyle continues in his quest to locate the avatars.

episodes.title: Witchness Protection
episodes.summary: Leo and the sisters are forced to protect the Seer when the Avatars insist she has valuable information about how to destroy a powerful group of demons, led by one called Zankou. The Seer then only agrees to help them gain the information they need if the Elders repay her by making her human. Paige and Darryl learn of what Kyle did to Inspector Sheridan. Piper finally learns of Leo's secret and contemplates the Avatars plan of creating a Utopian future.

episodes.title: Ordinary Witches
episodes.summary: When Paige takes Kyle back to the time when his parents were killed, Phoebe and Piper find themselves without their powers when Zankou uses his powers to transfer theirs to innocent bystanders, who then run amok before they are able to get their powers back. The Elders learn that Leo has become an Avatar.

episodes.title: Extreme Makeover: World Edition
episodes.summary: Despite Paige and her sisters' optimism about the Avatars vision of a Utopian future, Kyle doesn't share their positive outlook. He then forms an unlikely alliance with Zankou, but stipulates that the Charmed Ones don't get hurt in stopping the Avatars. As a result, Piper, Phoebe, and Paige fall under a spell that makes them extremely paranoid that causes them to attack an Avatar.

episodes.title: Charmageddon
episodes.summary: Now that the world has been changed to a conflict free Utopia, Leo becomes shocked and appalled at seeing that the Avatars choose who lives and dies. As a result, he decides to join forces with Zankou to change things back to how it was before. After things go back to normal, Leo has to face the consequences of going against the Elders. Paige is able to say a final goodbye to Kyle before he crosses over and starts working as a Whitelighter.

episodes.title: Carpe Demon
episodes.summary: As Paige begins interviewing possible teaching candidates to hire as Magic School's newest literature professor, one of the applicants is a reformed demon looking to start a new life doing good. However, it doesn't take long for a sorcerer to cast a spell and turn him into Robin Hood and Phoebe as one of his maidens and cause the mortal world to see the happenings of magical life. Meanwhile, Leo receives his punishment from the Elders for his betrayal, and Inspector Sheridan is back on the job and with no memory of what transpired between the sisters and Agent Brody.

episodes.title: Show Ghouls
episodes.summary: When Darryl goes to Piper, Phoebe, and Paige with the suspicions that his partner Mike has been possessed by some sort of magical being, they agree to help find out what's going on. However, Phoebe and Drake ultimately get transported back to the late 1880's when a famous Cabaret is destroyed in a fire. While there, the pair has to find out what happened that caused the fire or they'll be stuck in the past forever. Piper and Leo decide to stop worrying about the Elders might do to Leo and to live in the moment.

episodes.title: The Seven Year Witch
episodes.summary: Leo's punishment is handed down by the Elders – he is wiped of his memories and stripped of his powers, stranded out in a sparsely populated area and has to find his way back home in order to find out where he truly belongs. Meanwhile, as she is faced with a future without Leo in it, Piper is attacked by a powerful demon and ends up in a coma where she is fighting for her life. It is while hovering between life and death that Piper is shocked to discover Cole waiting to see her. Phoebe has to say goodbye to Drake.

episodes.title: Scry Hard
episodes.summary: When Zankou attempts to ambush Piper, Phoebe, and Paige in order to obtain the power of the Nexus and use it to his own advantage, little Wyatt takes matters into his own hands by shrinking Leo and Piper and hiding them in a doll house for protection while Phoebe and Paige have to deal with the demon and his henchmen. After stopping Zankou for the moment, the sisters talk Leo into becoming the new Headmaster of Magic School, hoping that he'll get used to no longer having his powers.

episodes.title: Little Box of Horrors
episodes.summary: When a shape-shifting demon gets and ultimately opens Pandora's Box, the sisters are tasked with tracking down the Guardian of the box so all the evil that is housed in it can be put back inside.

episodes.title: Freaky Phoebe
episodes.summary: When a powerful sorceress casts a spell to switch bodies with Phoebe in order to attack Zankou and his followers, Phoebe is stuck in the Underworld. As a result, of the switch, Phoebe is stuck in the sorceress' body when her sisters vanquish her. Meanwhile, Paige gets her first official Whitelighter charge and tries to persuade him to use his powers as needed. After a few demon attacks at P3, Inspector Sheridan suspects that the sisters are up to something, especially after a deliveryman gets injured.

episodes.title: Imaginary Fiends
episodes.summary: Posing as baby Wyatt's imaginary friend, a demon works his magic in an attempt to turn the toddler evil. When Piper decides to write a spell to understand what the toddler is saying, she accidentally brings Wyatt from 25 years in the future to the present. Things get tricky when the family discovers that future Wyatt is evil and eventually tries to squash all the good from baby Wyatt. When Leo discovers what the demon is up to, he sets out to help turn Wyatt good again.

episodes.title: Death Becomes Them
episodes.summary: Through the help of an evil alchemist, Zankou is able to cast a spell on the sisters to face the innocents they lost, thinking that it's the best and easiest way to weaken them and gain control of the Book of Shadows. Inspector Sheridan grows increasingly suspicious of Darryl after seeing him help Phoebe and tries to get him to confess that the sisters are evil. Paige get a new charge: a future Whitelighter and attempts to get her to continue down her path of goodness.

episodes.title: Something Wicca This Way Goes
episodes.summary: Now that Zankou has stolen the Book of Shadows, he learns he has to steal the powers from the sisters in order to be able to access all the spells and powers inside. Realizing what he has done, Piper, Phoebe, and Paige set out for one final showdown with the demon where their lives are at stake. Things get trickier for them when Inspector Sheridan leads a team of police officers to the manor, looking to take the sisters in for questioning.

episodes.title: Still Charmed and Kicking
episodes.summary: Presumed dead and looking to live a magic free life after their father holds a funeral for the sisters, Piper, Phoebe, and Paige start over with their magical new identities. However, as Whitelighter Paige gets a call to help an overconfident witch named Billie, a cocky demon who is posing as a real estate agent looks to get his hands on the manor to use it as an evil base above ground. Agent Keyes plans on keeping an agent nearby to stay on as a lookout in case the sisters resurface.

episodes.title: Malice in Wonderland
episodes.summary: A young demon who looks to gain control of the underworld suspects that the sisters are still alive and devises a plan to lure them out of hiding that involves plot lines from the story of Alice in Wonderland. However, it doesn't take long for Billie to realize what the demon is up to and goes after him by herself, only to become a victim as well and as a result, the sisters have to risk exposure to save her. Paige contemplates becoming a cop after being pulled over and Phoebe, in her new persona, is hired at the paper as the new advice columnist.

episodes.title: Run, Piper, Run
episodes.summary: While on a job interview, Piper is stunned to discover that her assumed identity is wanted for murder is ultimately arrested. As a result, Phoebe, Paige, and Billie set out to prove that "Jenny" isn't the person the authorities are looking for. Meanwhile, as Phoebe gets closer to Dex, she has a premonition of him caught in an earthquake.

episodes.title: Desperate Housewitches
episodes.summary: Wyatt's in a preschool play where a classmate's parent gets possessed by a demon looking to resurrect the source and creating the perfect demonic family by tricking the toddler to use his magical powers. Paige overreacts when she sees Dex get kissed by another woman. Meanwhile, Billie gets Leo and herself in a sticky situation when she talks Leo into taking her to see the Magic School, unaware that it's currently under demonic control and need to find a special spell to get back home before the demons find and attack them.

episodes.title: Rewitched
episodes.summary: When Billie uses her powers to save an innocent from a demon who attacks mortals by using a swarm of evil imps to do his dirty work, she is unaware that Agent Murphy is witnessing what's happening. As a result, Murphy suspects that the sisters are not really dead. Billie then causes more problems when she casts a spell that causes Phoebe to speed her relationship up with Dex. The sisters start to regret faking their deaths and with the help of Agent Murphy, decide to drop their secret identities with a convincing cover story.

episodes.title: Kill Billie: Vol. 1
episodes.summary: It's Halloween and Billie is determined to vanquish a demon called the Dogan. However, when she freezes upon meeting her target, she opens up to the sisters about when demons kidnapped her sister years ago on Halloween. She then casts an anti-fear spell on herself to see if that can help move past what happened all those years ago. Meanwhile, Paige decides to use a little magic on a reporter who won't leave the sisters alone, whereas Piper and Leo find themselves in a bit of a pickle. Phoebe is worried that she might be pregnant.

episodes.title: The Lost Picture Show
episodes.summary: As Paige contemplates returning to work as a Social Worker, she gets a visit from her father Sam, looking for help in locating J.D., an old charge of his who disappeared in the 1950's. While on the case, they discover J.D. was taken by a demon who pretends to be a doctor as cover to kidnap future Whitelighters and keeps them trapped in a photo collage.
